He fixes everything in her flat, always with a look that lingers too long. When the rent is due, she opens the door in a robe and nothing else, and says she wants to renegotiate.

tip: A toolbox and a wrench as props. Two adults, in your own home.
p: The kitchen sink is flooded. She is in a short robe when the plumber arrives and makes sure he has to kneel at her feet to reach the pipes. He eventually fixes more than the sink.
He calls the plumber because there is a leak in the bathroom, and she turns up with a smile and a cheeky comment about 'tightening his connections'. They end up soaked.

tip: Adults, a uniform, a feather duster and consent. Agree on limits and a stop word.
p: The maid keeps dropping things in front of the master, who finds her clumsiness impossible to ignore. He tells her she will have to be punished, then decides on a very thorough one over his knee.
She arrives to clean the master's bedroom and finds him waiting. He orders her to finish the job on her knees, then slowly rewards her for every task she completes.

tip: Consensual role-play with a clear safe word, agreed limits and a quick way out of any restraints. Only with a partner you trust.
p: He is the captor of a stubborn spy. She refuses to give up her secrets, so he ties her wrists with a soft scarf and decides the interrogation must be long, slow and completely at his mercy.
She wakes up in his lair, with a blindfold and a rope that is loose enough to escape but never quite does. He tells her that he has all night, and that she will beg before he is done.

tip: Two adults, a desk lamp and a chair. Agree a safe word and limits first.
p: The detective locks the door and sits on the edge of the desk. She is the suspect, who answers every question with a smirk. He decides to find out what she is hiding with his hands.
The agent is questioned in a dark room. Every wrong answer is punished with a slow, teasing touch, and every right one is rewarded with a kiss in a place she does not expect.

tip: Unroll a mat and play soft music. One of you teaches, the other follows.
p: The instructor corrects her pose with her hands on her hips, then her thighs, then lower. By the final stretch, the class is over and the only position left is the one the instructor has chosen.
She is the student who cannot touch her toes. The instructor says she has a private technique that will help, and shows her slowly, from behind, with a lot of heavy breathing.

tip: A suit, a desk and a closed office door. Two adults, a safe word.
p: The client is desperate to win the case. The lawyer asks her to prove how far she will go for the best defence, and they settle the fee on top of the boardroom table.
After the verdict, the lawyer asks the client to celebrate in private. She loosens his tie, shuts the blinds and says the fee is payable in full.

tip: A towel, a bottle of lotion and a sunny day. Two adults, in your own private space.
p: He rubs lotion into her back and her shoulders, slowly lower, and 'accidentally' undoes her top. She turns round, tells him it is fine, and asks him to continue.
The pool is empty and the attendant is closing up. She finds him alone, takes off her cover-up and asks him to help her with a very private swimming lesson.

tip: A dark suit, an earpiece and a hotel room. Adults, consensual.
p: The bodyguard has seen every move she makes. When the lights go off, he locks the door and tells her that he has been protecting more than her safety, and she can see how much.
He is the client, and the bodyguard is paid to keep him safe, all night. By morning, she has stripped him of every excuse for leaving the room.

tip: A fantasy affair between the two of you, with new names and a hotel room or bar setting. This is acted fantasy only.
p: She is a married woman waiting for her husband in a hotel lobby. A stranger starts talking to her, and an hour later she is in his room, with her wedding ring on the bedside table.
He is on a business trip. The woman he meets in the hotel bar knows exactly what she wants, and by midnight he has forgotten who he promised to call.

tip: A BDSM role-play for experienced couples. Agree on limits, aftercare and a safe word. Keep restraints loose and safe.
p: Tonight she is in charge. He kneels at her feet and she tells him exactly what he is allowed to touch, and what he is not. Every mistake is punished and every good boy is rewarded.
He is the dominant one, and she has promised to obey for one hour. A collar, a command and a blindfold decide the pace, and the safe word is the only thing between them.

tip: Turn off the lights and pretend to be in the dark. Two adults, in your own home.
p: She finds a burglar in her bedroom, and instead of calling for help she locks the door. The thief has to work out how to pay for his crime, and she has some ideas.
He is the burglar caught red-handed. The homeowner ties his hands with his own belt and decides that his punishment will start tonight.

tip: Light a candle and use a bottle or a lamp as a prop. One of you grants three wishes.
p: He rubs the lamp, and a very sultry genie appears. She grants three wishes, each one more explicit than the last, and says she cannot refuse any of them.
She finds a genie who is bound to obey. The first wish is for a massage, the second for a long night, and the third is whispered into his ear.

tip: Costumes optional, imagination required. Use a scarf as the rope.
p: The pirate captain has taken her ship. She refuses to talk, and he promises that the only treasure he wants is the one she is hiding under her dress.
She is the pirate queen who has taken a handsome sailor prisoner. She orders him to the cabin, ties him to the bed and plunders everything he has.

tip: Dim the lights, use a sheet as the spaceship. Two adults who enjoy being silly and sexy.
p: The alien needs to study the human body in great detail. He ties her down and runs his hands everywhere, noting each reaction. The experiment lasts all night.
She is the visitor from another world, and her human subject is very willing. She wants to understand pleasure, so she practises, again and again.

tip: A hotel room, a towel and a trolley. Two adults, a little teasing.
p: He is in the shower when the maid walks into the room by mistake. She apologises, but does not leave. The towel falls, and the next thing she cleans is him.
She is staying alone in a hotel and the maid comes to turn down the bed. They both know that this is not what she came for.

tip: Agree beforehand that one of you will pretend to sleep and the other will wake you with touch. Safe word and limits agreed. Only with a partner you trust.
p: She lies in bed, pretending to be asleep, and he slowly kisses her awake, from her ankles to her thighs. She lets him do everything and only wakes when she cannot hold it in.
He is asleep when she slips under the covers. She starts slowly, and by the time he opens his eyes, he has already lost control.

tip: This acts out a risky-sounding fantasy safely at home: a car, a stairwell, a lift or a balcony in your own private spaces only. No one else should be able to see or hear.
p: They are stuck in a lift between floors. She kneels, he leans back against the wall and the stalled lift does the rest, with the 'emergency' button used as a prop.
In the dark car, parked in their own garage, they act out sneaking away from a party. Windows fogged, seats back, quick and desperate, as if they might be caught.

tip: Pick a nice place, arrive separately and keep your voices low. Agree beforehand that either of you can say the safe word and the game stops.
p: She arrives first and takes a table by the wall in a flared dress. He sits at the next table and strikes up a conversation. Under the tablecloth, hands wander slowly while you both keep a perfectly polite face for the waiter.

You pretend to be strangers sharing a long communal table. He orders for her, she lets him, and every course is another small dare passed across the table until one of you says, 'Shall we skip dessert?'

t: The Call Girl and the Client
tip: Grown-ups playing paid-companion roles for one evening. Set a pretend 'fee' that is paid in favours, and keep the tone glamorous rather than rough.
p: He is a visiting businessman in a hotel bar. She is the elegant companion he has been told about. They discuss terms like a negotiation, then take it upstairs, where she insists he pays the whole 'bill' in attention.
She plays the client and he is the hired escort who must be flawless and attentive. She sets the rules and the pace for the night, and he must earn the tip.

tip: Use a car you are allowed to be in, a quiet private spot and no real street. Keep it a game: names, banter and a price agreed in advance.
p: She leans in at the car window and quotes her price with a wink. He plays the nervous customer who has never done this before, and she takes charge of the whole night.
Reverse it: he is the confident one working the corner, she is the stranger who pulls up. She asks for one thing and the price keeps changing as the conversation heats up.

tip: Everyone has a mask, so tonight nobody has a past. Wear something you would not normally wear and keep your names secret until midnight.
p: You come to a masked party as strangers. You spot each other across the room, dance once, then disappear into the coat room. You are not allowed to remove the masks until it is over.
It is Halloween and you are both in character: a vampire and a mortal, a genie and her master. Stay in character for the entire evening, even when you are back at home.

tip: Soft rope, scarves or silk ties only, and a pair of safety scissors within reach. Agree a safe word and check circulation often.
p: She asks him to teach her to tie a simple knot. He demonstrates on her wrists, stays calm and explains each step, and she slowly realises that this lesson was never about knots.
He is the one who has to be tied. She follows a diagram with great seriousness, ties him to the bed, and then pretends to forget the next step while she walks around the room.

tip: Decide in advance when you will swap: after a song, a drink or an hour. The swap itself is part of the game.
p: For the first half-hour one of you is completely in charge and the other has to ask permission for everything. When the timer rings you trade roles, and the new boss may undo or repeat anything.
Play a quick round of cards. The winner of each hand gives one order. Orders must be sexy, kind and doable, and the loser has to say 'yes' without arguing.
